cases.name: Celina Jackson
cases.narrative:
Police couldn’t confirm if Celina Jackson was raped, but “strongly suspect” she was, according to detective Gary Wichman. Her hands were tied behind her back and she was strangled with a pair of black leggings and her brother Wayne was strangled with a pink fleece blanket. He shoved her body and the body of her 18-month old brother in a closet.

cases.name: Heather Jackson
cases.about: Her aunt Sherry Jackson said, “She was a great mom, very outgoing and loved life. She loved her kids and her family.”
